trial_court: Family Court, Korba, District Korba (TPC No. 46 of 2024)
case_name: Smt. Khushbu Gupta vs Arjun Gupta
facts_of_case: Marriage between petitioner/wife and respondent/husband was solemnized on 19.05.2024. Petitioner/wife has filed an application under Section 125 of the Cr.P.C. seeking maintenance, which is pending as MJC Case No. 1043 / 2023 before the Family Court Durg.

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under section is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit.
legal_principles.held: Their Lordships of the Supreme Court has held as under: 'The cardinal principle for exercise of power under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.'
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya Vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik, (2022) SCC Online SC 1199

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both parties, their social strata, behavioural pattern, standard of life prior to and subsequent to marriage.
legal_principles.held: Their Lordships of the Supreme Court has held as under: 'In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood and under whose protective umbrella they are seeking their sustenance to life.'
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya Vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik, (2022) SCC Online SC 1199

outcome.final_order: Civil Suit No.2-A /2024 filed by respondent/husband in the Family Court, Korba may be transferred to Family Court, Durg.

use_for_drafting: assisting with transfer of cases between courts
